output: I understand why a jump at renewal would be hard to explain to your trustees, and it's a fair concern for a charity. Per-seat pricing does grow as more people adopt the platform, but there are ways to keep that growth predictable. Contributor and viewer seats cost less than full seats, so people who only need occasional access don't have to be priced like daily users, and a multi-year term can cap the annual increase. Here is the example we'd put in front of your trustees: [PROOF]. I'd be glad to send a three-year cost model at your expected user mix, with the renewal cap options side by side, so you can see exactly what each path would mean for your budget.

messages.content:
<quote>
And at renewal? We're a charity. A big jump at renewal would be very hard to explain to the trustees.
</quote>
